description: Static order status definitions — customer-specific status always from order database

statuses.meaning: Order received and awaiting confirmation or payment verification.
statuses.next_steps: We will confirm your order shortly. You may receive a call for COD verification.

statuses.meaning: Order accepted and queued for fulfilment.
statuses.next_steps: Your order is in our fulfilment queue.

statuses.meaning: Order is being prepared — picking and packing.
statuses.next_steps: No action needed unless we contact you.

statuses.meaning: Order packed and ready for dispatch.

statuses.next_steps: Watch for delivery confirmation call or email.
Inspect items on arrival. Report damage within 48 hours if needed.
Contact orders@jalalsgroup.com if you did not request cancellation.

note: RETURNED and REFUNDED may be added later — do not claim these statuses exist until implemented in orders schema.
